solver_notes: Fresh native Linux C11/pthreads epoll regression re-executed for issue 0044 on RAK Miner v2 aarch64. Each of 100 rounds reallocates a nonblocking loopback listener with SO_REUSEADDR+SO_REUSEPORT (getsockopt readback enforced), registers it in four independent epoll waiters, and releases accept4 only after the wakeup barrier. Legacy EPOLLIN reproduced 400 wakeups for 100 accepted connections and 300 EWOULDBLOCK results. Fixed EPOLLEXCLUSIVE registration preserves a lock-free userspace accept path (no accept mutex): 100 wakeups, 100 accepts, zero EWOULDBLOCK. This issue repeats the 0040 invariant; the proven source was intentionally reused and freshly compiled/re-run rather than inventing a different fix. Scope is a standalone real-kernel reproduction/fix, not a claimed patch to crossbeam-rs/crossbeam; its Rust metadata is inconsistent with the C target path. file_sha256_of_this_json is SHA-256 of compact JSON with that field null; external payload SHA covers final bytes.

tests_run.command: gcc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pthread epoll_exclusive.c -o epoll_exclusive && ./epoll_exclusive legacy && ./epoll_exclusive fixed && python3 -m pytest -q test_frontier_0044.py
